the teachers in this project have been able to develop a shared awareness of LAC and the need for further action, and that this has been facilitated by the support from the school leadership and a collaborative action research approach.
the development of a LAC learning community is possible in a school context that is characterized by a majority language that influences the school language in many ways.

collaborative action-research principles can work as an organizational structure and drive for continuous learning around LAC, and that the school leadership plays a central role in supporting the teachers’ learning process.

a learning community around language and learning.
the development of a LAC learning community in a multilingual setting and the conditions and factors that are seen as important in the process.
the development and evaluation of a model of collaborative action research as a means to build a learning community around LAC.

this project is in a process of becoming, and the learning process is far from complete.
the project has shown the importance of the school leadership in the process of building a learning community around LAC.

the process has been successful in that the school leadership has taken a clear stance in support of the project and the participating teachers have developed their didactic competence and their awareness of the situation.
the process of LAC is not just about language, but about learning.
